text:

Assuming you and the [COMPANY] team might be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev.

We'll be at the conference so let me know when works best for you and I can get it booked in! Feel free to swing by our booth (#1123) as well.
